menu.pitch: A swarm hunts you. The arena fills in. Survive the wave.

settings.fpsHint: Limited to what your display can show
settings.frameTimeGraphHint: Shows simulation and draw time per frame in the top-left corner. The dashed line is the frame budget of the selected target FPS. Measures script work only, not GPU time. The bottom row adds the load figures: frames actually drawn per second, drawing operations per frame, and canvas pixels. Those explain GPU cost but still do not measure it — read GPU time in the browser's own profiler.
settings.frameTimeGraphModeHint: Separate plots simulation and draw time as their own curve; combined plots one curve for the whole frame.
